differentCases.publicQuestion: Find the first names that are used for professionals or owners but are not used as dog names.

responses:
SELECT people.first_name
FROM (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM Owners
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT first_name
    FROM Professionals
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL
) AS people
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Dogs
    WHERE Dogs.name = people.first_name
)
ORDER BY people.first_name;
submit

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name
FROM (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM Owners
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT first_name
    FROM Professionals
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL
) AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Dogs AS d
    WHERE d.name = p.first_name
);
submit

differentCases.publicQuestion: What is the name of the course with the most students enrolled?

responses:
SELECT c.course_name
FROM Courses c
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sec ON c.course_id = sec.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name
ORDER BY COUNT(sec.student_course_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name,
       COUNT(*) AS enrollment_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT se.student_id) AS distinct_students
FROM Courses c
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sec ON c.course_id = sec.course_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON sec.student_enrolment_id = se.student_enrolment_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name
ORDER BY enrollment_rows DESC, distinct_students DESC;
submit

SELECT c.course_name
FROM Courses c
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sec ON sec.course_id = c.course_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON se.student_enrolment_id = sec.student_enrolment_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT se.student_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
